frames.frame: [介词短语] is/was [真正主语(+修饰从句)]
frames.gloss: 介词短语前置的倒装判断句：系动词前的名词才是表语，后面的名词短语才是真正主语。
frames.notes: 主语后置带长修饰，易误把表语当主语。

examples.text: At issue is the TMT's planned location on Mauna Kea, a dormant volcano worshiped by some Hawaiians as the piko, that connects the Hawaiian Islands to the heavens.
Among the annoying challenges facing the middle class is one that will probably go unmentioned in the next presidential campaign: What happens when the robots come for their jobs?

frames.gloss: come 携带后置主语引出即将到来的事件，when/that 从句补充说明该名词。
frames.notes: come后主语倒置，word/day带同位从句。

examples.text: There will eventually come a day when The New York Times ceases to publish stories on newsprint.
Now comes word that everyone involved – Democrats, Republicans, the Postal Service, the unions and the system’s heaviest users – has finally agreed on a plan to fix the system.

frames.frame: [Exactly when/Just how/Whether 小句] is [表语]
frames.gloss: 疑问词或 whether 引导的主语从句作全句主语，后接判断性表语。
frames.notes: 从句作主语跨度长，易与疑问句混淆。

examples.text: Exactly when that day will be is a matter of debate.

Just how people think is still far too complex to be understood, let alone reproduced, says David Eagleman, a Stanford University neuroscientist. “We are just in a situation where there are no good theories explaining what consciousness actually is and how you could ever build a machine to get there.
Whether this research translates elsewhere is anybody's guess.

frames.gloss: 插入语「照通行说法/其思路是」，标记前后内容是他人流传的观点而非作者立场。
frames.notes: goes=说法是，插入句中易漏读立场标记。

examples.text: I would raise prices and make it into more of a legacy product." The most loyal customers would still get the product they favor, the idea goes, and they'd feel like they were helping sustain the quality of something they believe in.
Why, the argument goes, should a car-driving pensioner from Lincolnshire have to subsidise the daily commute of a stockbroker from Surrey?

frames.gloss: 引语被报道结构从中间切断：前半句直接引语 + 报道动词与人名 + 后半句续引语。
frames.notes: 引语中插报道，需跨插入语拼回原话。
frames.related: 引语后置报道：'[直接引语]', says/explains [NP]

examples.text: There is one and only one social responsibility of business," wrote Milton Friedman, a Nobel prize-winning economist, "That is, to use its resources and engage in activities designed to increase its profits.
The ancient Hawaiians were astronomers," wrote Queen Liliuokalani, Hawaii's last reigning monarch, in 1897.
The basic compact underlying representative government," wrote Chief Justice John Roberts for the court, "assumes that public officials will hear from their constituents and act on their concerns.

frames.gloss: 「正当……之时/之际」，时间关系从句隐含与主句的背景对比。
frames.notes: 暗含对照背景，非单纯时间。
frames.related: [时间NP] when [S V]（when 关系从句）

examples.text: The infrastructure required to make a physical newspaper - printing presses, delivery trucks - isn't just expensive; it's excessive at a time when online-only competitors don't have the same set of financial constraints.
Scientific publishers routinely report profit margins approaching 40% on their operations at a time when the rest of the publishing industry is in an existential crisis.

frames.gloss: 先给肯定项再用逗号加 not 否定对照项，可嵌在 for A to do 或句尾。
frames.notes: 否定项后置修正，嵌套时最易读错。

examples.text: But the ruling reinforces the need for citizens and their elected representatives, not the courts, to ensure equality of access to government.
The implication is that Millennials prefer news from the White House to be filtered through other sources, not a president’s social media platform.
But "it's us, human beings, we the people who create the society we want, not profit.

frames.frame: It is/was [介词短语/A rather than B] that [S V]
frames.gloss: 分裂强调的强化变体：焦点为介词短语（背景状语）或带 rather than 的对比项，可整体嵌进 that 从句里。
frames.notes: 强调焦点非基本款名词，嵌套时最难点。

examples.text: It is against that background that the information commissioner, Elizabeth Denham, has issued her damning verdict against the Royal Free hospital trust under the NHS, which handed over to DeepMind the records of 1.6 million patients in 2015 on the basis of a vague agreement which took far too little account of the patients’ rights and their expectations of privacy.

Their analysis ruled out the possibility that it was firms' political influence, rather than their CSR stand, that accounted for the leniency: Companies that contributed more to political campaigns did not receive lower fines.
Successive governments have permitted such increases on the grounds that the cost of investing in and running the rail network should be borne by those who use it, rather than the general taxpayer.

candidates.gloss: 前一否定句延续：也不……（助动词倒装）。

examples.text: Nor does it reveal how much companies are banking on the halo effect, rather than the other possible benefits, when they decide their do-gooding policies.

It has become a grimly reliable annual ritual: every January the cost of travelling by train rises, imposing a significant extra burden on those who have no option but to use the rail network to get to work or otherwise.

candidates.gloss: 远远不及……（程度差得远的否定同级比较）。

examples.text: AI “vision” today is not nearly as sophisticated as that of humans.

candidates.gloss: 尽管/纵然（让步缩略，接短语不接从句）。

examples.text: She is proud that several sculptures have even gone on display again, albeit sometimes beneath protective cases.

candidates.gloss: 撇开……不谈，则……（名词+aside 让步）。

examples.text: Nostalgia for ink on paper and the rustle of pages aside, there's plenty of incentive to ditch print.

candidates.frame: This is not to say that [A], but rather [B]
candidates.gloss: 这并不是说A，而是强调B（澄清-重定向）。

examples.text: This is not to say that there is no point in getting a degree, but rather stress that a degree is not for everyone, that the switch from classroom to lecture hall is not an inevitable one and that other options are available.

candidates.frame: It is all very well [S V-ing], but [主句]

examples.text: It is all very well train operators trumpeting the improvements they are making to the network, but passengers should be able to expect a basic level of service for the substantial sums they are now paying to travel.

candidates.frame: There is a strong case that [S should V]
candidates.gloss: 有充分理由主张……（论证引入）。
candidates.notes: a case for/that 论证框架。

examples.text: However, there is a strong case that those who have been worst affected by industrial action should receive compensation for the disruption they have suffered.

candidates.gloss: 句尾省略回指：或很快也会（如此）。

examples.text: But many middle-class occupations – trucking, financial advice, software engineering – have aroused their interest, or soon will.

candidates.gloss: 结果可能证明是……（推测+事后检验）。

examples.text: We are still at the beginning of this revolution and small choices now may turn out to have gigantic consequences later.

candidates.gloss: 悬置条件问句：那要是……呢？（主句刻意省略）

examples.text: And if Peretti were in charge at the Times?

candidates.gloss: 条件插入语：若真实施/成立，则主句……。

examples.text: The bans, if fully enforced, would suggest to women (and many men) that they should not let others be arbiters of their beauty.

candidates.frame: [清单], to name but a few
candidates.gloss: 仅举几例（列举收尾，示清单未尽）。

examples.text: They have included Britain's DPT. (diverted profits tax), Australia's MAAL (multinational anti-avoidance law), and India's SEP (significant economic presence) test, to name but a few.

candidates.gloss: 非限定从句表连锁反应：这反过来又……。

examples.text: But it has already sparked significant controversy, with the United States trade representative opening an investigation into whether the tax discriminates against American companies, which in turn could lead to trade sanctions against France.

candidates.frame: For those for whom [S V], [主句]
candidates.gloss: 对那些……的人来说，（则如何）。

examples.text: For those for whom a degree is the desired route, consider that this may well be the first of many.

candidates.gloss: ……几乎无法被……（tough句：主语是不定式的逻辑宾语）。

examples.text: Yet that demand has been almost impossible to fill—in part because of pushback from broadband providers, anti-regulatory conservatives and the courts.
